outline.title: Power chords
outline.summary: Two- and three-note shapes that drive rock music.

lessons.title: Power chords on the E string
lessons.summary: Play E5 and move the same shape up the low E string.

lessons.title: Power chords on the A string
lessons.summary: Move the shape to the A string and find any root.

lessons.title: Power chord changes
lessons.summary: Jump between E- and A-string shapes in time.

lessons.title: Palm muting
lessons.summary: Rest the side of your hand on the strings for a tight, chugging sound.

lessons.title: A muted rock rhythm
lessons.summary: Mix palm-muted eighths with open accents in a rock groove.

outline.title: Your first barre chords
outline.summary: F and Bm, and the technique that makes them ring.

lessons.title: Barre technique
lessons.summary: Press one finger across all strings with the bony edge, not the pad.

lessons.title: F major
lessons.summary: Build the full F barre chord string by string.

lessons.title: B minor
lessons.summary: Play Bm on the A string with a partial barre.

lessons.title: Changing to barre chords
lessons.summary: Move between open chords and F or Bm without losing the beat.

lessons.title: Barre endurance
lessons.summary: Hold barre chords through a full verse without tiring.

outline.title: Movable shapes
outline.summary: One shape, every key: using the neck to find any chord.

lessons.title: Notes on the low strings
lessons.summary: Learn the note names along the E and A strings.

lessons.title: E-shape barre chords
lessons.summary: Slide the F shape up the neck to play G, A and B.

lessons.title: A-shape barre chords
lessons.summary: Use the A-string shape for C, D and E major and minor.

lessons.title: Progressions with movable shapes
lessons.summary: Play a whole progression with barre chords only.

lessons.title: Stage song: Greensleeves
lessons.summary: Play the traditional English tune's chords with barre and power shapes.
